name: What are the typical phases of a kitchen remodel with HH Remodeling LLC?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical phases of a kitchen remodel with HH Remodeling LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an on-site consultation to review your space, discuss goals, and evaluate structural, plumbing, and finish needs. Following the initial estimate and planning phase, the job proceeds to demolition and any custom wall framing. Licensed trade partners complete the rough plumbing and electrical rough-ins before our crew installs drywall, taping, and texturing. Once walls are prepped, we install cabinetry, coordinate countertop template and installation, complete tile work, and handle finish carpentry and trim. A final walkthrough ensures all details meet quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: The project moves from on-site consultation and demo to trade rough-ins, drywall, cabinet installation, countertops, tile, trim, and a final walkthrough.
